usedFor: Eventzilla holds registrations, and Razorpay collects the money through “Create Payment Link” or “Create Invoice”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: A registration is the moment to ask for payment, and the link carries amount, expiry and customer details.

watchOut: “Attendee Check-In Changes” runs on every change, so it can create a second payment link for one person.
